_comment: Leaderboard records that survive a redeploy.
This app runs on a Render free instance, which has NO persistent disk:
every deploy rebuilds the container from a fresh git checkout, so
everything in data/ (including scores-<room>.json) is wiped. Anything
listed here is merged back in at boot by loadScores() in server.js.
Rules: an entry here only ever RAISES a score, never lowers one. If the
same player has a higher live score, theirs wins; if they later score
lower, the record below still stands. Keys are room ids ('meowmeow',
'cookie'). To add a record, copy the shape below.
Entries are records people actually set. Don't invent them.
Not seeded, because the standings they came from listed no score:
snake/fatty (6th), tetris/x (10th), cookie/Dr goon (10th). Add a
score for any of them here and they'll appear.
